name: Papaa... Mou Yametee.... ~Manamusume e no Shitsuke wa Nikubou de~
original_name: パパァ…もうやめてぇ…。 ～愛娘へのしつけは肉棒で～
source: Kashima Takeo catches his daughter masturbating in her room. Unable to control his desire he rapes her. Can he fix their broken relationship?
translation: 鹿島武夫撞見女兒在房間裡自慰。他無法控制慾望，強姦了女兒。他能修復兩人破裂的關係嗎？
